title: Dell OpenManage Enterprise, versions prior to 4.8.0, contains an Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a…
description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise versions prior to 4.8.0 have a vulnerability involving improper neutralization of argument delimiters, which could allow a low privileged attacker with adjacent network access to execute commands. The vulnerability is classified as medium severity with a CVSS score of 4.6. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
